independence_evidence: Site footer reads '© BRICKS MEDIA LTD', a small UK company publishing only this title and selling it through its own Big Cartel shop; no media-group ownership.
qualifies_reason: Independently published UK print title with issue #15 (2026) sold through the publisher's own shop and #14 released in 2025.
what_it_is: BRICKS is a UK fashion and culture magazine with an activist streak, pairing cover interviews with musicians, models and public figures (issue #15 has covers including Leigh-Anne Pinnock, Lucy Dacus, Jordan Stephens, Richie Shazam and Zack Polanski, plus one honouring Palestinian journalists) with fashion editorials and essays on social issues. Each themed issue appears roughly once a year with multiple covers and is accompanied by a running online edition. It suits readers of youth-culture fashion titles who want politics and community woven into the mix.

uncertainties: bricksmagazine.co.uk rate-limited direct requests (HTTP 429) and its about page returns 404, so publisher details rest on the footer ('© BRICKS MEDIA LTD') and the shop; the city is not stated on the site and London is recorded from the issue's own text ('arrived in London') and the title's London-based team, so treat it as unconfirmed. Issue #15 pre-orders opened 1-24 April 2026; magCulture listed it 11 Aug 2026 and the distributor hint says July 2026, so the on-sale date is recorded as July 2026 (month precision) and could be a month or two earlier. Issue #14 was listed by Village Books in Sept 2025, giving one issue per year for 2025-26. Trim size and page count not stated.
